name: Ui_EquipRow_SetMemberEquipCells
summary: Stores the member id and fills the row's six equipment cells with the member's equipped item names/colours, with the two-handed second-hand special case.
evidence: Body uses func_0035EB98 member record, func_006292F0 equipped ids, func_0066C5CC two-handed check, Text_FormatMessageArg names; cells carry text not icon ids, so 'SetIcons' is imprecise.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_FillItemRelatedRows
summary: For an item id, walks related rows from the data manager and fills up to five rows of three columns with item name, storage/quantity and count text, blanking the rest.
evidence: Three fixed column pane ids and five-row limit visible; Item_LookupRecord, Item_GetStoragePointer, Text_FormatMessageArg used, but no named caller and record helpers unnamed.

name: Ui_EquipCompare_SetSlotPanes
signature: void Ui_EquipCompare_SetSlotPanes(void* self, int characterId, const u16* slots)
summary: Compare variant of the equip row: fills six slot panes with equipped item names, colouring each by whether it matches the compared item id, with a two-handed special case.
evidence: Same six cells, func_006292F0 equipped ids, colour selected by id match and ItemRecord category; no named caller identifies the owning window.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaySeForItemType
summary: Plays a sound depending on the object's item id: SE 10 for ids 0xAA3..0xB3A and SE 0xE for 0xA82..0xAA2, via Sound_CommandQueue_Push_2.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord and Sound_GetPlayer/CommandQueue_Push_2 named; two hard id ranges visible; no named caller confirms the object is a field gimmick.

name: Ui_ListRow_GetLabelStyle
summary: Returns 1 for item ids 0xA19..0xA81, otherwise searches the model's 12-byte row entries for rowId and returns that entry's second halfword as the label style, or 0.
evidence: Item range and per-row return byte clear; poker-window callers use it to pick row representation, but the byte could be a type/colour index.

name: Ui_EquipSlot_FindNextForItem
summary: Advances the row's slot index (0..10) to the next equipment slot that accepts the item by walking the 0x1C-byte slot table and calling its per-slot predicate, stopping when the index wraps.
evidence: Named callers Ui_Row_RefreshValue and Ui_Row_SetIndex prove a Ui row helper; 0x0072960C slot table plus per-slot virtual predicate supports the slot-search reading.

name: Party_MemberHasItemEquipped
signature: u32 Party_MemberHasItemEquipped(u32 memberId, u32 itemId, u32 arg3)
summary: If the member is active, returns 1 when one of its six equip slots holds an item whose base/variant id matches the given item through func_0066C368.
evidence: func_0035EB98 member record, Party_IsMemberActive, func_006292F0 equipped id and func_0066C368 variant match all named; unused third parameter and no named caller keep it moderate.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemIcon_UpdateOwnedState
summary: No dossier or decompiled body available, so the current uncertain name is retained.
evidence: No dossier (no readable file); nothing to verify.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_SetTableRows
summary: Fills up to 10 list rows from the data-manager record of idRecord[0], formatting each related item id via Item_LookupRecord/Text_FormatMessageArg and blanking the remaining rows.
evidence: Row-fill loop with Item_LookupRecord and Text_FormatMessageArg is clear, but no caller and the record helpers 0x0063E1B4/0x0063E998 are unnamed, so the owning window and columns stay inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCurseMark
summary: For the row's item, tests ItemRecord flag +0x20 bit 0: clear pushes the pane at owner+0x120 and plays equipment-window animation 0x1D, set formats string id 0x1C into owner+0x1084 and pushes that pane.
evidence: Flag test and the two Ui_Window_PushPane/Ui_EquipmentWindow_PlayAnim branches are clear, but nothing proves bit 0 means 'cursed' and there is no named caller.

name: maybe_Ui_MessagePage_AddItemNameArgs
summary: Per node kind (+6: 0x0C, 0x0A, 0x0B) formats the node's value into the message buffer at *0x007AC834+0x950 using Message_SetArg/Text_FormatMessageArg.
evidence: Message_SetArg and Text_FormatMessageArg are named and the kind switch is visible, but the page/owner part of the name is inferred and callers are unrelated subsystems.

name: maybe_Item_GetVariantName
summary: Formats the item referenced by func_0063E998(id & 0x7FFF) into a message-argument buffer, returning an empty string when the record is missing.
evidence: Body fully read and uses Game_GetDataManager + func_0063E998 + Text_FormatMessageArg, so 'format item name' holds; the 0x8000 mask meaning and lack of caller keep maybe_.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList
summary: Clears the list at self+0x8A/0x8B and, unless func_00242754 is set, walks every item id 0..0xB3A with Item_LookupRecord collecting matching ones.
evidence: Item loop bound 0xB3B and Item_LookupRecord are certain, but the Thumb start is damaged decompilation and there is no named caller, so the list's purpose stays vague.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateListAlt
summary: Second item-candidate builder: same 0..0xB3A item walk as 0x002C2144 with a different acceptance filter.
evidence: Same loop shape and callees as 0x002C2144 (Item_LookupRecord, func_00242754, func_0066C368) but no caller and no named filter helper, so the distinct filter and name stay inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_UpdateQuantityRows
summary: Fills one 16-row page from the 4-byte entries at self+0x1F0 (count from func_00668C84), writing each entry's name and count into the row panes.
evidence: 16-row page fill and entry count are visible and Item_LookupRecord/Text_FormatMessageArg are named, but no caller and func_00668C84/func_006F0E1C are unnamed, so 'quantity' and the owning window stay inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_BuildItemDescription
signature: void maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_BuildItemDescription(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Damaged decompilation in the shop-window block; only partly survives around Item_LookupRecord and Text_FormatMessageArg, so its exact job cannot be stated.
evidence: Body is still damaged (flag-register and unaffected-register use) and per FACTS.md a damaged body keeps maybe_ and confidence <= 0.3.

name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_BuildPriceText
summary: Shop-window step called from Ui_ShopWindow_BuildSelectedItemText: sets self+0x1A90 = 0x1C, lazily creates the shared data-manager object, then looks up the selected item record and copies it into self+0x54; no price string is actually built.
evidence: Only caller is Ui_ShopWindow_BuildSelectedItemText; body sets one field, lazily allocates the g_dataManager singleton, and calls Item_LookupRecord on the selected row into self+0x54; Text_FormatMessageArg is called but no price formatting is visible.

name: Item_CreateViewModelDesc
signature: void* maybe_Item_CreateViewModelDesc(void* self, u32 kind, u32 itemId, u8 variant, u32 extra)
summary: Allocates a UI row/scroll descriptor for an item, choosing the vtable by the item's kind field (+0x11) and by func_0066C3A0 (kinds 6/7); used by the equipment window to build its detail rows.
evidence: Sole caller is the named Ui_EquipmentWindow_Update; body switches on ItemRecord->f_11 and assigns g_uiEquipPartyListDeltaRowVtable / g_uiEquipDetailScrollVtableA, i.e. equipment-window row descriptors.

name: maybe_Item_GetNameVariantTag
signature: void maybe_Item_GetNameVariantTag(u32* out, ItemRecord* record, int slot)
summary: Scans up to four variant ids (record+0x22C) of an item and writes the first variant the player owns (ownership bitmask at work+0x295C8) into out, else a default; no caller names the owning UI.
evidence: Loop over uVar6 < 4 with Item_LookupRecord, func_0066C368 variant match and bitmask test at work+0x295C8; writes one of two entries of g_itemTextColorTable to *out. No callers.

name: maybe_Item_HasOwnedNameVariant
summary: Returns 1 when any of the item's variant ids is set in the ownership bitmask at work+0x295C8, walking consecutive ids while func_0066C368 still matches the base id.
evidence: Body tests bitmask at work+0x295C8 for each variant id resolved via Item_LookupRecord/func_0066C368 and returns 1/0; no callers to confirm the 'name variant' meaning.

name: maybe_Item_FormatNameWithVariant
summary: Formats the variant item (record+0x22C) when that variant exists and matches, otherwise the base item, through Text_FormatMessageArg.
evidence: Body looks up base and variant records, checks func_0066C368 match, then calls Text_FormatMessageArg on the chosen record; no caller names the owning UI.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_A
summary: Clears the candidate list and walks item ids 0..0xB3A with Item_LookupRecord, keeping items with flags 0x20 set, 0x40 clear and id in 0x32..0xA3, deduplicated by func_0066C368.
evidence: Loop bound 0xB3B with Item_LookupRecord and func_0066C368 dedup is certain; filter is flags 0x20/0x40 plus id-0x32 < 0x72, but no caller identifies the list owner.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ExcludeThreeClasses
summary: Item-id walk 0..0xB3A that keeps flagged items but excludes three item classes (kind 0x25, 0x26, 0x27 and ids above 0x31), collecting the rest into the candidate list.
evidence: Same loop as sibling with extra checks on ItemRecord->f_c against 0x25/0x26/0x27 and id > 0x31; no caller names the list owner.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_CardRange
summary: Item-id walk that keeps ids 0xA19..0xA81 (the playing-card item block) and collects them into the candidate list.
evidence: Range check id-0xA19 < 0x69 is explicit in the body; no caller names the list owner.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ByCategory
summary: Walks all 0xB3B item records, keeps those with the 0x20 flag set, 0x40 clear and ItemRecord+0x0C equal to the category argument, and appends their ids to a u16 list at self+0x0A with count at self+0x8A.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord over 0xB3B rows, flag test on +0x20, category compare against local_1c->f_c, dedup append into self+0x0A; no caller identifies the list owner.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ThreeFilters
summary: Same 0xB3B item walk with the 0x20/0x40 flag gate, additionally requiring one of three item predicates (func_0066CCEC/func_0066C978/func_0066C950) before appending the id to the u16 list.
evidence: Identical list-append skeleton as 0x002C3E30 but the category compare is replaced by an OR of three predicate helpers; no caller.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ByCategoryRange
summary: Item walk bounded by 0x91B+0x220 that keeps equipment-range ids (0xA4..0x9BF or 0xB19..0xB1C) whose ItemRecord+0x29 equals the category argument, appending them to the u16 list.
evidence: Explicit bounds 0x91B/0x220, equipment id range check id-0xA4<0x91B || id-0xB19<4, and local_24->f_29 == category; matches established equipment-range fact.

name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_TwoFilters
summary: 0xB3B item walk with the 0x20/0x40 flag gate plus an OR of two equip-category predicates (func_0066C5A8 one-handed / func_0066C5CC two-handed) before appending the id to the u16 list.
evidence: Same append skeleton; predicate OR of func_0066C5A8/func_0066C5CC which the facts tie to 1H/2H equip categories; no caller.

name: maybe_Item_AssignEquipSlotItem
signature: void maybe_Item_AssignEquipSlotItem(void* self, int slotMode, u32 itemId)
summary: Writes itemId into the equip-slot word (self+0x0E + slotMode*2) and, when the new or old item is two-handed, validates the equip category against the currently equipped item before committing self+0x10.
evidence: Writes (short*)(self+slotMode*2+0xE), Item_LookupRecord + func_0066C5A8/func_0066C5CC two-handed checks, compares ItemRecord+0x29; single caller Effect_UpdateBillboardOrientation is likely a misnamed neighbour.

name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_BuildDetailWidget
summary: Builds the recipe-detail widget when the book is open and the mode word has none of 0x142 set, copying a style template and registering the node list; otherwise requests the detail state.
evidence: Ghidra reports bad instruction data and halt_baddata, and the body reads overlapping globals; Ui_RecipeBook_* neighbours and callees support the subsystem but not the exact construction variant.

name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_SelectRecipe
signature: u32 maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_SelectRecipe(int recipeIndex, int window, u32 arg3, int row)
summary: Selects a recipe row: if Recipe_CanCraft(recipeIndex*0x11) fails it releases the row object and returns 1; otherwise it fills the detail record at window+0x1E4, builds the material list and party entries and dispatches command 5 to the state object at +0x11C.
evidence: Recipe_CanCraft and Ui_RecipeBook_BuildMaterialList/FillPartyEntries pin the recipe-row path, but the decompilation reads unaff_r5/r6/r7/r8 and in_r12 so argument roles are unreliable.

name: maybe_Ui_StatusWindow_UpdateState
summary: Per-frame update of the status window: bails while busy, waits on the transition state at self[2], handles the 0x4A8/0x4AA/0x94 flags, and in state 3 rebuilds the party summary bytes at GameWork+0x2E2F4/+0x2E2F5 before setting state 0x3D.
evidence: Named callees Ui_Window_SetState, Ui_StatusWindow_CountActiveSlots and Party_GetSecondRowNameLength support the status-window reading; only caller is maybe_Ui_DiveStartWindow_CreatePartB so the owning window is uncertain.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_StepBranchOnFlag8
summary: Message-window control step that releases the window, tests progress flag bit 8, pushes tag bytes 0x20..0x25 or 0x20/0x21, then executes the next control code; semantics of the tags remain an interpretation.
evidence: Calls Message_TestFlagMask(...,8), Ui_Root_SetFlagBits, Ui_Root_ReleaseAll, Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode; callers are credit-window/list-screen functions, no direct message-script caller; tag semantics unproven.

name: maybe_Script_ThumbStub_2CC714
signature: void maybe_Script_ThumbStub_2CC714(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int* loop, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, int* refcounted)
summary: Ghidra-damaged Squirrel/FS helper that walks a 0x14-byte record array and releases ref-counted temporaries; operation unknown.
evidence: Bad instruction data, lost argument registers; only callees (Script_ReadSerializedValue, Script_ObjectPtr_Assign, Script_ReadClosureRef, Fs_UnmountByName) identify the subsystem.

name: maybe_Script_VM_RunClosure
signature: void maybe_Script_VM_RunClosure(unsigned int vm, unsigned int closure, void* fn, unsigned int arg4)

evidence: Named Squirrel callees and Script_RegisterHook caller confirm VM code, but 5KB body is truncated with halt_baddata so 'RunClosure' is a guess.

name: maybe_Save_LoadSlotRecords

name: maybe_Item_CollectIdsFromBag
summary: No dossier or readable file available; name cannot be verified.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_AdvancePage5

summary: List-window page 9/10 handler: updates page widget, builds mode-5 entries and requests action 0x0C on confirmation, otherwise requests 0x10/0x11 from root singleton.
evidence: Body drives Ui_Widget_Update, Ui_ListData_BuildEntries(mode 5), Ui_PromptRef_IsFirstChoiceConfirmed, pageId 9/10 checks; no callers to confirm role.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_OpenPage4
signature: void maybe_Ui_ListWindow_OpenPage4(u32 self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Prepares page 4 of the list window: resets choice window, sets list count, builds mode-4 entries and requests action 0 or 2 based on Party_GetSecondRowNameLength.
evidence: Calls Ui_ChoiceWindow_ResetOptions, Ui_ListData_BuildEntries(mode 4), Party_GetSecondRowNameLength; no callers to confirm.

name: maybe_Party_SumSkillCostScaled
summary: Sums per-skill byte at record+6 over learned skills the character can unlock in the given slot and multiplies by 20 (display units).
evidence: Named callers Ui_SkillPanel_OnCursorMove/Ui_MessagePage_ExecuteCommand and twin 0x003AAB38 (raw sum) establish raw vs scaled pair; byte meaning (cost/damage/points) unproven.

name: maybe_Ui_SkillList_CollectPruned
signature: void maybe_Ui_SkillList_CollectPruned(UiSkillList* self, int characterId, int slot)
summary: Builds the character's usable skill list by copying the 60-entry skill table, blanking entries not present in the requested slot and repeatedly dropping skills whose prerequisites are missing, compacting survivors into the u16 list.
evidence: Callers Ui_SkillPanel_OnCursorMove/Ui_MessagePage_ExecuteCommand and callee SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill support a skill-list prune, but the exact semantics of the slot filter and the 0x1C-byte record remain inferred.

name: maybe_Party_SumSkillCost
summary: Sums the per-skill byte at record+6 over every learned skill of the character that passes the slot filter, returning the raw sum.
evidence: Same body as 0x003AA448 without the *20; uses Party_CountLearnedSkills, SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill and the skill record helper, but the summed byte's meaning is still inferred.

name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateUnitsForSubMode2
summary: When the action sequence is in sub-mode 2 with sub-state 1..3, iterates all battle units and dispatches a per-unit update on each.
evidence: Gate on self->f_1260->u8_1F8==2 and u8_1F9 in 1..3, virtual +0x10C unit count, and six named battle-sequence callers; the per-unit callee 0x001FD10C is unnamed so the operation stays inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipmentDetail_ScrollNameA
summary: One direction of the equipment detail's member-name scroll: opens the wrapped detail page when the name cursor is 0, otherwise measures the member's name, advances the cursor and pushes the item's detail page, closing at the end.
evidence: Named callees Ui_Window_PushPane, Ui_Panel_ResetAndPush, Item_LookupRecord and Item_RollStatBoostDelta prove an equipment window, but which vtable direction this slot handles is not established.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipmentDetail_ScrollNameB
summary: Second direction of the same name scroll: clamps the member cursor into [0, max], sends the consumed delta as page command 10, and pushes command 0x32 when the current item id is equipment.
evidence: Same named callee set as 0x003D6480 plus the equipment id-range test (0xA4/0xB19), but the scroll direction is still not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_Panel_OpenDetailForCurrentId
summary: Epilogue shared by the equipment detail handlers: refreshes the UI, asks the panel for its current 16-bit item id, and either pushes the panel's detail page or tears the panel down when the id is 0.
evidence: Body is damaged (coprocessor_store, unaff_r4) and Ghidra lost the receiver; the owner+0x10CC store and Ui_Panel_ResetAndPush/0x0019AD70 close path match the epilogue of 0x003D6480/0x003D6750.

name: Ui_MessageWindow_CreateParts
signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CreateParts(UiMessageWindowParts* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Creates the two child widgets of a window part holder: a 0x230C timer-display object stored at self+4 and a 0x9C4 message window at self+8, registering each with the UI object table and binding its panels/callbacks.
evidence: Allocations via Ui_TimerDisplay_Ctor and Ui_MessageWindow_CreatePartsB, registration through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, and the named caller Ui_UpdateWindowParts support the create-parts reading; the holder also owns a timer so the name is slightly narrow.

name: Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateDetailListEx
signature: void maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateDetailListEx(UiSmithMenu* self, u32 controller, u32 row)
summary: For an explicit row, resolves the row's name string into the name widget at self+0x2B4 and pushes the row's entry and count into the detail widget via Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair.
evidence: Named callers Ui_SmithMenu_HandleCommand/SelectRow/CommitRow and the shared sink Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair with the row count from func_003813B0+8 support the explicit-row detail update.

name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandC
summary: One of five poker deal variants: shuffles the 13-card deck and 4-card page list, exchanges five hand slots with random deck positions, then rolls the rank chance and either swaps the last slot or rotates the hand. The C variant tag cannot be matched to a specific game rule.
evidence: Called only by Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate; calls Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck13/Deck4, Math_RandMod4, Casino_Poker_RollHandRankChance. Variant letter unverified.

name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandE
summary: Another poker deal variant: three fixed deck exchanges, a second deck-4 shuffle, seven random page exchanges, then the rank-chance roll decides whether the last slot is swapped with a random hand position, ending with the shared hand rotation. The E label is arbitrary.
evidence: Same helper family as the other dealer variants (ShuffleDeck13/Deck4, func_00416638 slot exchange, RollHandRankChance); only caller is Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate. Variant letter unverified.
